title: boechera formosa
intro: Boechera formosa, commonly known as alpine rock cress, is a perennial plant species native to North America. Alpine rock cress has been traditionally used to support respiratory health, and its leaves are rich in antioxidants, which may contribute to its potential anti-inflammatory and anti-bacterial properties. Studies suggest that its bioactive constituents, including isothiocyanates and sesquiterpenes, may exert therapeutic actions such as bronchodilation and antimicrobial activity, making it a potential natural remedy for respiratory issues and wound healing. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of alpine rock cress on human health and its potential medicinal applications.
